status.description: Lifecycle status. The minih MCP runtime validates every state_transition and state_set against this enum: an out-of-enum status is rejected with MCP_INVALID_ARGUMENT (see validateInsideState in src/mcp/tools/state.ts). The agent prompt teaches these statuses; prompt-vs-enum drift is additionally flagged at authoring time by `minih doctor` (prompt-state-vocabulary-drift).

data.description: Free-form scratch — e.g. current task id, files being read, partial findings count.
